description: Statically analyze an LLM-agent repo (LangGraph / CrewAI / OpenAI-Agents-SDK) for runaway-budget risk WITHOUT running it. Builds a .py-only archive of the given local path and returns a worst-case budget summary: counts of certifiable / default_dependent / non_certifiable / runaway graph units and a pass|fail verdict. Use before deploying a workflow to catch missing token caps and while-True runaway drivers.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Python repo/directory to analyze.

name: costwright_check
